result.brief: 提出统一扩散模型 CineDub，无需裁剪人脸或说话人分离即可从原始视频完成多说话人对话配音，并联合生成语音与连贯音效，同时发布两个真实场景基准。
result.reason: Unified diffusion model dubs multi-speaker dialogue from uncropped video and jointly generates speech plus coherent sound effects, directly matching video-to-speech and audio-video joint generation interests.
